title: Terms of the Agreement: Completion of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)
content:
**Terms of the Agreement, Part E — Completion**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)

**E.1** An agreement is completed when its last installment has been billed and the arranged balance is zero. The agreement then passes from active to completed status.

**E.2** A completed agreement leaves no hold on disconnection for later bills.

**E.3 Retired clause.** The following clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis for an early payoff:

> ~~Where the tier allows early payoff, the member may pay off the agreement at any time: the unbilled balance is billed back as an early payoff, the tier's early payoff fee, where above zero, is billed as a service fee, and the agreement is completed on the same day.~~ — no longer in force.

**Reading Part E**

| Record of the agreement | Completed under E.1 |
|---|---|
| last installment billed, arranged balance zero | yes |
| last installment not yet billed | no |

*Is a bill issued after completion protected from disconnection by the finished agreement?* No. Under E.2 a completed agreement leaves no hold on disconnection for later bills.

superseded_clauses: Where early_payoff_allowed is true the member may pay off the agreement at any time: the unbilled balance is billed back with rebill_reason early_payoff, the early_payoff_fee where above zero is billed as a service fee, and the agreement is completed on the same day.
